fr.elements: Main Residence; Solar Panel System; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Multiple Structures; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Mark the location of the solar system disconnect on the exterior of the house so responders can find it without searching.
• Keep a clear path along at least one side of the house connecting the front driveway to the rear detached structure.
• Keep the side path wide enough for a responder carrying equipment to pass without obstruction.
• Mark the detached structure with its own address or unit identifier if it contains living space or stored hazardous materials.
• Keep the parking area clear of vehicles that would block the driveway as the only access point to the property.
• Trim any landscaping along the side path that forces responders to push through growth when moving between structures.
• Post the solar system shutdown instructions near the main electrical panel or disconnect in a weatherproof sleeve.
